clips.title: Random Kits
clips.caption: A twelve-player round with three lives each. Kills, falls and lava deaths scroll through chat as the arena empties out.

clips.title: Voting menu
clips.caption: Picking the next game. Each option shows its average rating, your own rating and how many players have voted for it.

clips.title: Powers of Fortune
clips.caption: Everyone gets a new power every 20 seconds, such as Snowball Fighter or Super Jump. The last player alive wins.

clips.title: Beat the Boss
clips.caption: A fight against the Corrupted Evoker, a custom multi-stage boss that summons toxic clouds and waves of fangs.

clips.title: Pet system
clips.caption: The pet menu: choose a pet, open its settings, and spend coins to upgrade stats such as health.

clips.title: Hatching a pet
clips.caption: A legendary camel hatches with a +44% gold boost. Recorded January 2025.

clips.title: Pillar of Chaos
clips.caption: Pillars of random blocks rising out of the arena floor at the start of a round.

clips.title: Spawn and map builds
clips.caption: A flythrough of the hand-built spawn, castle and arenas.

clips.title: Audio and proximity voice chat
clips.caption: Circuit's browser audio client carried in-game music and proximity voice chat for players within 45 blocks. Recorded January 2025.

clips.title: Circuit promo
clips.caption: An early promotional cut for the server, showing Random Kits, Team Platform and the map lineup.
